title: Constraint-Preserving Flow Matching for Spectral Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spectral graph generation models graphs through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of their Laplacians, providing a compact and continuous alternative to direct graph construction. However, these eigensystems must retain the structural properties of graph Laplacians. Existing approaches preserve eigenvector orthonormality but do not enforce the Laplacian nullspace constraint, potentially producing eigensystems inconsistent with Laplacian structure. To address this, we introduce Laplacian-Constrained Stiefel Flow Matching (LaSFM), which preserves the nullspace condition alongside eigenvector orthonormality and positive eigenvalues during generation. We characterize the underlying constrained Stiefel manifold and formulate flow matching on it. translated_title: 面向谱图生成的保约束流匹配
translated_abstract: 谱图生成通过图拉普拉斯矩阵的特征值和特征向量来建模图，为直接图构建提供了一种紧凑且连续的替代方案。然而，这些特征系统必须保留图拉普拉斯矩阵的结构性质。现有方法虽然保留了特征向量的正交归一性，但并未强制执行拉普拉斯零空间约束，可能产生与拉普拉斯结构不一致的特征系统。为解决这一问题，我们提出了拉普拉斯约束Stiefel流匹配，在生成过程中同时保持零空间条件、特征向量正交归一性以及正特征值。我们刻画了底层的约束Stiefel流形，并在其上构建流匹配。我们进一步将LaSFM扩展到属性引导的生成，在保持这些约束的同时，将样本引导至期望的图属性。实验表明在谱生成任务上取得了性能提升。
tldr: 提出了LaSFM方法，在谱图生成过程中通过在约束Stiefel流形上进行流匹配，同时保持拉普拉斯零空间约束、特征向量正交性和正特征值，并可扩展至属性引导的图生成。
en_tdlr: LaSFM performs flow matching on a constrained Stiefel manifold to preserve the Laplacian nullspace constraint alongside eigenvector orthonormality and positive eigenvalues in spectral graph generation, and extends to property-guided generation.
